lines.label: DEXTRA · Even G2 + Telegram
lines.text: This is DEXTRA, an Even G2 app. Agree something out loud, and the other person confirms it in Telegram. Here's how to use it.

lines.label: Step 1 · Start the simulator
lines.text: Step one. Clone the repo and run npm run try. The official Even simulator opens DEXTRA, connected to the live server.

lines.label: Step 2 · Link Telegram
lines.text: Step two. Send the code on the lens to Dextra Agree Bot, and add the bot under Chat Automation.

lines.label: Step 3 · Open the chat
lines.text: Step three. From the other person's account, send yourself any message. That opens Telegram's reply window.

lines.label: Step 4 · Agree, hold, send
lines.text: Step four. Agree something near the mic, hold to lock it, and click to send.

lines.label: In the simulator
lines.text: On the lens, DEXTRA shows who promised what, each line backed by their words. One click sends it as you.

lines.label: In Telegram
lines.text: The other person gets it in your chat and taps Confirm. Then you both tick items off as they're done.

lines.label: It can't invent promises
lines.text: The AI only proposes. Try to slip in a promise nobody made, and it's refused before it reaches the lens.

lines.label: Real records
lines.text: These are real records from the live database. Flip one for its timeline and fingerprint, or mask the names before a screen share.

lines.label: Measured
lines.text: A hundred and twelve tests pass, and on our eval no invented promise got through. DEXTRA. Said, and done.
